description: 专利摘要汇编、专利文摘、专利阅读清单。当用户说「把这些专利整理成摘要合集」「这批专利分组给研发看」「做一份专利阅读资料」时使用，输出摘要表与可阅读的文摘文件。 Turn a supplied list of patent numbers or search-result files into a grouped abstract digest and reading index, preserving source abstracts and linking every summary to its patent number.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
